children: Spyre reported SPY003 met the primary endpoint with a 10.0-point RHI reduction at Week 12 and showed supportive remission and endoscopic improvements.
SPY003 achieved primary endpoint: −10.0 change in RHI at Week 12 (p<0.0001), establishing proof-of-concept.
Clinical remission rate 20% and endoscopic improvement 30%; mMS improved by −3.5 through Week 12 (N=44).
SPY003 safety profile consistent with IL-23 class: 43% had any AE, 7% SAEs (none drug-related), no drug-related SAEs or deaths.
Results align with SPY001/SPY002 monotherapy RHI reductions, supporting planned combination strategy in SKYLINE Part B.
Part B is actively enrolling (two monotherapy doses plus three high-dose combinations); topline induction data expected in 2027.
